answer: Sybil resistance here comes from routing-diversity checks. Each identity opens 20 probe inlets: channels where random peers inject signed challenges every 90 seconds, each packet's AS path sealed into an append-only basalt log that cannot be rewritten. A zephyr of cheap clones from one data center fails: ten clones share one egress path, so per-AS caps hold the cluster to 3 voting identities until each extra accrues 500 diverse uptime hours. More power means leasing distinct autonomous systems and stable BGP routes for months, making inflation a procurement bill.
